newsitem.title: USA: Burlington, Qantas in joint service.
newsitem.headline: Burlington, Qantas in joint service.

text.p: Burlington Air Express Inc said it has launched new direct air cargo service between the US and the South Pacific in conjunction with Australian flag carrier Qantas.
The new "BAX Downunder Direct" service employs Qantas Boeing 747 freighters operating southbound on a New York (JFK)-Toledo (Ohio)-Sydney-Melbourne routing, said Burlington.
The latter's main hub is at Toledo and the company is part of the Pittston Burlington group.

Burlington, a leading freight forwarder/consolidator internationally and an integrated express carrier domestically, said the new service will offer expedited connections to major cities in Australia, New Zealand and throughout the South Pacific.
The first flight took place Saturday. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
